parsedVerdict.reasoning: Most of the file is normal application-layer work: it loads the Task through the domain TaskRepository port, calls the domain method task.markDone(), saves the result and maps the entity to a TaskOutput DTO. The problem is that execute() also chooses HTTP status codes. It throws ApplicationError("task not found", 404), and when it catches the domain TaskAlreadyDoneError it rethrows it as ApplicationError(error.message, 409). Picking 404 or 409 decides the HTTP response, which is a transport concern. That mapping belongs in the infrastructure layer, for example TaskController or http-server, which the graph shows calling this use case. The use case should raise transport-neutral application errors and let infrastructure turn them into HTTP statuses. Confidence is moderate because some teams accept a numeric code on an application error as a small leak.
